entities.commonMisinterpretations: Treating named biases as immutable defects or assuming one parameter estimated in one task transfers unchanged to all decisions.
entities.definition: The degree to which options with unknown or imprecise probabilities are valued less than comparable options with known probabilities.
entities.evidenceNotes: Supported by established theory, validated measures, and converging review, meta-analytic, experimental, or longitudinal evidence. Magnitude and behavioral direction remain conditional on context. Representative records: SRC189; SRC123.
entities.family: Decision Valuation Across Risk, Time & Effort
entities.measurementAssessmentMethods: Incentivized or hypothetical choice tasks; adaptive titration; model-based parameter estimation; structured self-report
entities.measurementCaveats: Estimated parameters can be task-, domain-, stake-, and model-dependent; descriptive regularities are not fixed universal traits.
entities.mechanism: Adds a subjective penalty to options whose outcome probabilities are unclear.
entities.moderatorsBoundaryConditions: Domain, wealth or resource state, experience, numeracy, affect, time pressure, and elicitation method.
entities.name: Ambiguity Aversion
entities.persistenceRecovery: Can shift with framing and state; stable individual differences are only partly persistent.
entities.polarityDirection: Higher values = stronger avoidance of probability ambiguity.
entities.representationScale: Choice premium; ambiguity-aversion parameter; low–high scale

entities.commonMisinterpretations: Treating named biases as immutable defects or assuming one parameter estimated in one task transfers unchanged to all decisions.
entities.definition: The degree of difficulty or tension produced by similarly valued, incompatible options or uncertain tradeoffs.
entities.evidenceNotes: Scientifically defensible with substantial supporting literature, while causal identification, construct boundaries, measurement, or transferability remain context dependent. Representative records: SRC192; SRC115.
entities.family: Decision Valuation Across Risk, Time & Effort
entities.measurementAssessmentMethods: Incentivized or hypothetical choice tasks; adaptive titration; model-based parameter estimation; structured self-report
entities.measurementCaveats: Estimated parameters can be task-, domain-, stake-, and model-dependent; descriptive regularities are not fixed universal traits.
entities.mechanism: Delays choice, increases information search, and raises susceptibility to defaults or avoidance.
entities.moderatorsBoundaryConditions: Domain, wealth or resource state, experience, numeracy, affect, time pressure, and elicitation method.
entities.name: Decision Conflict
entities.persistenceRecovery: Usually task-bound and rapidly reversible, although learning and fatigue can produce longer effects.
entities.polarityDirection: Higher values = greater conflict among active options.
entities.representationScale: Low–high conflict; response-time or indecision index

entities.commonMisinterpretations: Treating named biases as immutable defects or assuming one parameter estimated in one task transfers unchanged to all decisions.
entities.definition: The degree to which an option's designation as the preselected or status-quo choice increases its subjective preference.
entities.evidenceNotes: Supported by established theory, validated measures, and converging review, meta-analytic, experimental, or longitudinal evidence. Magnitude and behavioral direction remain conditional on context. Representative records: SRC193; SRC113.
entities.family: Decision Valuation Across Risk, Time & Effort
entities.measurementAssessmentMethods: Incentivized or hypothetical choice tasks; adaptive titration; model-based parameter estimation; structured self-report
entities.measurementCaveats: Estimated parameters can be task-, domain-, stake-, and model-dependent; descriptive regularities are not fixed universal traits.
entities.mechanism: Defaults imply endorsement, reduce effort, and establish a reference point, increasing passive selection.
entities.moderatorsBoundaryConditions: Domain, wealth or resource state, experience, numeracy, affect, time pressure, and elicitation method.
entities.name: Default Option Preference
entities.persistenceRecovery: Can shift with framing and state; stable individual differences are only partly persistent.
entities.polarityDirection: Higher values = stronger preference shift toward the default.
entities.representationScale: Choice-rate difference or individual default-susceptibility estimate

entities.commonMisinterpretations: Treating named biases as immutable defects or assuming one parameter estimated in one task transfers unchanged to all decisions.
entities.definition: The rate at which the subjective value of an outcome decreases as delay to receipt increases.
entities.evidenceNotes: Supported by established theory, validated measures, and converging review, meta-analytic, experimental, or longitudinal evidence. Magnitude and behavioral direction remain conditional on context. Representative records: SRC126; SRC190.
entities.family: Decision Valuation Across Risk, Time & Effort

entities.measurementCaveats: Estimated parameters can be task-, domain-, stake-, and model-dependent; descriptive regularities are not fixed universal traits.
entities.mechanism: Shifts preference toward sooner outcomes and away from delayed consequences.
entities.moderatorsBoundaryConditions: Domain, wealth or resource state, experience, numeracy, affect, time pressure, and elicitation method.
entities.name: Delay Discounting
entities.persistenceRecovery: Can shift with framing and state; stable individual differences are only partly persistent.
entities.polarityDirection: Higher values = steeper devaluation of delayed outcomes.
entities.representationScale: Hyperbolic or exponential discount parameter; indifference points

entities.measurementCaveats: Estimated parameters can be task-, domain-, stake-, and model-dependent; descriptive regularities are not fixed universal traits.

entities.name: Effort Discounting
entities.persistenceRecovery: Can shift with framing and state; stable individual differences are only partly persistent.
entities.polarityDirection: Higher values = steeper devaluation as required effort increases.

entities.name: Loss Aversion
entities.persistenceRecovery: Can shift with framing and state; stable individual differences are only partly persistent.
entities.polarityDirection: Higher values = greater relative weighting of losses over gains.

entities.commonMisinterpretations: Treating named biases as immutable defects or assuming one parameter estimated in one task transfers unchanged to all decisions.

entities.evidenceNotes: Supported by established theory, validated measures, and converging review, meta-analytic, experimental, or longitudinal evidence. Magnitude and behavioral direction remain conditional on context. Representative records: SRC126; SRC190.

entities.name: Present Bias
entities.persistenceRecovery: Can shift with framing and state; stable individual differences are only partly persistent.
entities.polarityDirection: Higher present bias = greater extra preference for immediate outcomes.
entities.representationScale: Beta parameter; preference reversal across immediate versus delayed choices
